name: RMS scaling without centering
input: nonzero-mean rows and distinct feature scales
test:
import torch
x = torch.tensor([[3., 4.], [-1., 7.]])
gamma = torch.tensor([2., -0.5])
y = rms_norm(x, gamma)
expected = torch.nn.functional.rms_norm(x, (2,), gamma, eps=1e-5)
assert y.shape == x.shape and y.dtype == x.dtype
assert torch.allclose(y, expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5)
assert y[0].mean().abs() > 0.1
print('ok')

name: zero and single-feature rows
test:
import torch
for x in (torch.tensor([[0., 0.], [0.001, -0.002]]), torch.tensor([[3.], [-4.], [0.]])):
    gamma = torch.full((x.shape[-1],), 2.)
    y = rms_norm(x, gamma, eps=0.25)
    expected = torch.nn.functional.rms_norm(x, (x.shape[-1],), gamma, eps=0.25)
    assert torch.isfinite(y).all() and torch.allclose(y, expected, atol=1e-6)
print('ok')

name: float64 and unchanged inputs
test:
import torch
for x in (torch.tensor([[1., 4.], [-2., 8.], [3., 9.]], dtype=torch.float64).T, torch.tensor([[1., 4., 9.]], dtype=torch.float64)):
    gamma = torch.tensor([0.5, 2., -1.], dtype=x.dtype)
    old_x, old_gamma = x.clone(), gamma.clone()
    y = rms_norm(x, gamma, eps=0.02)
    expected = torch.nn.functional.rms_norm(x, (3,), gamma, eps=0.02)
    assert y.shape == x.shape and y.dtype == x.dtype
    assert torch.allclose(y, expected, atol=1e-9, rtol=1e-7)
    assert torch.equal(x, old_x) and torch.equal(gamma, old_gamma)
print('ok')
